scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p app/portal/tsconfig.json
scripts.app:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply monolith-app-staging --local --config app/wrangler.jsonc --env dev
scripts.app:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply monolith-app-staging --remote --config app/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.app:check: npm run typecheck && npm run app:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config app/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config app/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.app:deploy:staging: npm test && npm run app:build && wrangler deploy --config app/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
